arXiv:2606.19236v1 [cs.LG] 2026 年 6 月 17 日arXiv:2606.19236v1 [cs.LG] 17 Jun 2026

STARE：意外引导的代币级优势重新加权以实现策略熵稳定性STARE: Surprisal-Guided Token-Level Advantage Reweighting for Policy Entropy Stability

Haipeng Luo   Qingfeng Sun   Songli Wu   Can Xu   Wenfeng Deng
Han Hu   Yansong Tang†
Shenzhen International Graduate School, Tsinghua University
Tencent Hunyuan
{luohp24@mails., tang.yansong@sz.}tsinghua.edu.cn
{victorqsun,leocaxu}@tencent.com   Corresponding authors. This work was done during Luo’s internship at Tencent and was supported by the CIE-Tencent Ph.D. Student Research Incentive Program (Tencent Hunyuan Special Fund).
摘要Abstract

具有可验证奖励的强化学习算法（例如 GRPO）已成为法学硕士复杂推理的主要训练后范式，但在训练过程中通常会遭受策略熵崩溃。我们对 GRPO 下的代币级熵动力学进行一阶梯度分析，并识别代币级信用分配不匹配：每个代币的熵变化分解为轨迹级优势和下一个代币分布上的熵敏感性函数的乘积，产生优势-令人惊讶的四象限结构和近临界性属性。受此启发，我们提出了 STARE (Surprisal-guided Token-level Advantage Reweighting forpolicy Entropy stable)，它通过批量内部的意外分位数识别熵关键的令牌子集，有选择地重新加权其有效优势，并结合目标熵闭环门来实现稳定的熵调节。在从 1.5B 到 32B 的模型规模和三个任务系列（短 CoT、长 CoT 和多轮工具使用）中，STARE 可以在数千步上维持稳定的 RL 训练，同时将策略熵保持在目标范围内。在 AIME24 和 AIME25 上，STARE 的平均准确率比 DAPO 和其他竞争基线高 4%–8%，反射标记和响应长度同步增长，表明持续的探索-利用平衡，进一步释放 RL 训练潜力。代码可在Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards algorithms like GRPO have emerged as the dominant post-training paradigm for complex reasoning in LLMs, yet commonly suffer from policy entropy collapse during training. We conduct a first-order gradient analysis of token-level entropy dynamics under GRPO and identify a token-level credit assignment mismatch: the per-token entropy variation decomposes into the product of the trajectory-level advantage and an entropy sensitivity function over the next-token distribution, yielding an advantage-surprisal four-quadrant structure and a near-criticality property. Motivated by it, we propose STARE (Surprisal-guided Token-level Advantage Reweighting for policy Entropy stability), which identifies entropy-critical token subsets via batch-internal surprisal quantiles, selectively reweights their effective advantages, and incorporates a target-entropy closed-loop gate for stable entropy regulation. Across model scales from 1.5B to 32B and three task families (Short CoT, Long CoT, and Multi-Turn Tool Use), STARE sustains stable RL training over thousands of steps while maintaining policy entropy within the target band. On AIME24 and AIME25, STARE outperforms DAPO and other competitive baselines by 4%–8% in average accuracy, with reflection tokens and response length growing in tandem, indicating sustained exploration–exploitation balance that further unlocks RL training potential. Code is available athttps://github.com/hp-luo/STARE

1 简介Introduction

具有可验证奖励的强化学习 (RLVR) 已成为法学硕士中引出复杂推理的主要训练后范式，如 DeepSeek-R1、Qwen3 和 Kimi K1.5 所示Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as the dominant post-training paradigm for eliciting complex reasoning in LLMs, as exemplified by DeepSeek-R1, Qwen3, and Kimi K1.5(Guo et al., 2025; Achiam et al., 2023; Team et al., 2025a; Team, 2025; Anthropic, 2025)。 RLVR算法中，群体相对策略优化（GRPO）省去了价值网络，而是采用群体归一化奖励作为优势估计的基准；它已被广泛应用于数学推理、代码生成中，并能有效诱导长子推理和自我反思等紧急行为. Among RLVR algorithms, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) dispenses with the value network and instead employs group-normalized rewards as the baseline for advantage estimation; and it has been widely adopted in mathematical reasoning, code generation, and is effective at inducing emergent behaviors like long-cot reasoning and self-reflection(Shao et al., 2024; Schulman et al., 2017).

然而，随着 RL 训练扩展到更多优化步骤，GRPO 式算法通常会遭受策略熵崩溃的困扰：熵迅速衰减，输出多样性消失，策略过早收敛，组内推出同质化，降低相对优势估计并最终限制可训练步骤，这是长期后训练的关键瓶颈As RL training extends over more optimization steps, however, GRPO-style algorithms commonly suffer from policy entropy collapse: entropy decays rapidly, output diversity vanishes, the policy converges prematurely, and within-group rollouts homogenize, degrading relative advantage estimation and ultimately capping trainable steps, a critical bottleneck for long-horizon post-training(Yue et al., 2025a; Farquhar et al., 2024)。现有的缓解措施分为三个方向。 (i) 调整重要性采样比率的剪裁阈值（即 DAPO 的剪裁较高）可以保护低概率的探索性代币，但会对熵产生不对称且不可控的影响，并且在比率保持在 1 附近的在政策体制中基本上不活跃. Existing mitigations fall into three directions. (i) Adjusting the clipping thresholds for the importance-sampling ratio (i.e., DAPO’s clip-higher) protects low-probability exploratory tokens, but exerts an asymmetric and uncontrollable effect on entropy and is largely inactive in the on-policy regime where the ratios stay near one(Yu et al., 2025; Chen et al., 2026; Xi et al., 2025; Fu et al., 2026)。 (ii) 正和负推出之间的不对称轨迹级别权重：增加罕见正确推出的权重或偏向负样本的更新，提供粗粒度控制. (ii) Asymmetric trajectory-level weighting between positive and negative rollouts: Upweighting rare correct rollouts or biasing updates toward negative samples, provides coarse-grained control(Zhu et al., 2025; Tang et al., 2025; Wang et al., 2025b; 2026; Yang et al., 2025b; He et al., 2025a; 2026)。 (iii) 熵感知优势重塑​​或熵正则化将令牌级熵耦合到优势中，但往往会过度放大高熵令牌，引发振荡，并保持超参数敏感. (iii) Entropy-aware advantage reshaping or entropy regularization couples token-level entropy into the advantage, but tends to overamplify high-entropy tokens, induce oscillations, and remain hyperparameter-sensitive(Cheng et al., 2025; Cui et al., 2025; Xu et al., 2025; He et al., 2025c; Yang et al., 2025a; Huang et al., 2025)。这些方法在不同程度上减缓了熵衰减，但在轨迹或样本粒度上运行，缺乏对崩溃机制的原则性解释。有两个问题仍然悬而未决：哪些代币会在 GRPO 下驱动熵衰减，以及多强的干预足以扭转它。. These approaches slow entropy decay to varying degrees, yet operate at trajectory or sample granularity, lacking a principled account of the collapse mechanism. Two questions remain open: which tokens drive entropy decay under GRPO, and how strong an intervention suffices to reverse it.

我们对 GRPO 下的代币级熵动力学进行一阶梯度分析，并识别代币级信用分配不匹配：尽管轨迹级优势We conduct a first-order gradient analysis of token-level entropy dynamics under GRPO and identify a token-level credit assignment mismatch: although the trajectory-level advantageA^i\hat{A}_{i}在一次部署中的所有代币之间共享，每个代币的熵贡献分解为以下的乘积is shared across all tokens within a rollout, the per-token entropy contribution decomposes into the product ofA^i\hat{A}_{i}和局部熵敏感性函数and a local entropy sensitivity functionΦ\Phi由下一个令牌分布确定（部分determined by the next-token distribution (Section3）。这种分解产生了优势-意外四象限视图：在正优势轨迹内，低意外令牌主导采样频率并驱动大多数熵减少更新，而可能增加熵的罕见高意外令牌被稀释（镜像不对称适用于负优势轨迹）。我们建立了近临界属性：轻微的令牌级权重扰动足以翻转熵演化的符号，并且对特定权重值具有鲁棒性，并且超过临界阈值，权重调节熵偏移的大小而不是方向。). This decomposition yields an advantage–surprisal four-quadrant view: within positive-advantage trajectories, low-surprisal tokens dominate the sampling frequency and drive most entropy-decreasing updates, whereas the rare high-surprisal tokens that could raise entropy are diluted (a mirror-image asymmetry holds for negative-advantage trajectories). We establish a near-criticality property: a mild token-level weight perturbation suffices to flip the sign of entropy evolution and is robust to the specific weight value and beyond the critical threshold, the weight modulates the magnitude rather than the direction of the entropy shift.

受这些因素的推动，我们提出了 STARE（意外引导的代币级优势重新加权以实现政策熵稳定性），这是一种微创代币级信用再平衡机制，在 GRPO 的裁剪代理内部运行。 STARE通过批次内部惊喜分位数选择熵关键令牌子集，从而有选择地放大正优势高惊喜令牌的有效优势并削弱负优势高惊喜令牌的有效优势。目标熵闭环门进一步控制干预：当批量平均熵达到一定值时，重新加权被激活以恢复探索Motivated by these, we propose STARE (Surprisal-guided Token-level Advantage Reweighting for policy Entropy stability), a minimally invasive token-level credit-rebalancing mechanism that operates inside the clipped surrogate of GRPO. STARE selects an entropy-critical token subset via batch-internal surprisal quantiles, thereby selectively amplifying the effective advantage of positive-advantage high-surprisal tokens and attenuating that of negative-advantage high-surprisal tokens. A target-entropy closed-loop gate further governs the intervention: the reweighting is activated to restore exploration when the batch-averaged entropyH¯k\bar{H}_{k}低于目标水平drops below a target levelHtgtH_{\text{tgt}}，并在熵恢复后恢复为 GRPO，从而产生闭环、稳定和低侵入的熵调节。, and reverts to GRPO once entropy recovers, yielding closed-loop, stable, and low-intrusion entropy regulation.

我们在多个模型规模和任务体系中验证 STARE。在 7B 模型上，STARE 稳定维持超过 5k RL 训练步骤；在 14B 和 32B 型号上，它支持超过 1.5k 步；在整个训练过程中，策略熵保持在目标范围内。在涵盖短 CoT、长 CoT 和多轮工具使用代理的三个任务系列中，STARE 在 AIME24 和 AIME25 上始终优于 DAPOWe validate STARE across multiple model scales and task regimes. On 7B models, STARE stably sustains over 5k RL training steps; on 14B and 32B models, it sustains over 1.5k steps; throughout training, the policy entropy is held within the target band. Across three task families spanning Short CoT, Long CoT, and multi-turn tool-use agents, STARE consistently outperforms DAPO on AIME24 and AIME25 by4%4\%-8%8\%平均准确度方面，与反射相关的标记和响应长度同步增长，表明探索-利用平衡得到改善。in average accuracy, with reflection-related tokens and response length growing in tandem, indicating an improved exploration–exploitation balance.

这项工作的主要贡献如下：（i）通过一阶熵动力学分析，我们揭示了 GRPO 中代币级的信用分配不匹配，并建立了近临界属性：轻微的权重扰动足以翻转熵演化的方向，同时对权重值保持鲁棒性。 (ii) 我们提出了一种基于意外的优势重新加权机制，结合目标熵闭环约束，通过对 GRPO 目标的最小修改来实现稳定的政策熵调节，并在数千步上维持 RL 训练。 (iii) 我们在从 1.5B 到 32B 的模型规模以及短 CoT、长 CoT 或多回合工具使用制度中验证 STARE，它保持稳定的政策熵，并且以一致的幅度大幅优于 DAPO 和其他基线。我们将相关工作的讨论推迟到附录The main contributions of this work are as follows: (i) From a first-order entropy-dynamics analysis, we expose the token-level credit assignment mismatch in GRPO and establish a near-criticality property: a mild weight perturbation suffices to flip the direction of entropy evolution while remaining robust to the weight value. (ii) We propose a surprisal-based advantage reweighting mechanism coupled with a target-entropy closed-loop constraint, achieving stable policy-entropy regulation through a minimal modification to the GRPO objective and sustaining RL training over thousands of steps. (iii) We validate STARE across model scales from 1.5B to 32B and across Short CoT, Long CoT, or multi-turn tool-use regimes, where it maintains stable policy entropy and substantially outperforms DAPO and other baselines by a consistent margin. We defer the discussion of related work to AppendixA.

Motivated by it, we proposeS惊奇引导urprisal-GuidedToken级别oken-LevelA优势dvantageR政策加权eweighting For PolicyE熵稳定性ntropy Stability（凝视）(STARE)：一种基于意外的信用再平衡机制，在GRPO的剪裁代理内运行，为熵关键代币分配差异化权重，并结合目标熵闭环反馈以实现训练时的稳定熵调节，如图所示: a surprisal-based credit rebalancing mechanism that operates within the clipped surrogate of GRPO, assigns differentiated weights to entropy-critical tokens, and incorporates target-entropy closed-loop feedback for stable entropy regulation on training, as shown in Figure2.

6 结论Conclusion

我们提出了 STARE，一种意外引导的代币级优势重新加权机制，可以减轻 GRPO 式 RLVR 中的策略熵崩溃。熵动力学的一阶分析揭示了一个优势——令人惊讶的四象限结构和近临界特性。在这一见解的指导下，STARE 通过批量内部意外分位数重新加权熵关键型代币，并结合目标熵闭环门以实现稳定、侵入性最小的调节。在 1.5B-32B 模型和三个任务场景中，STARE 维持了数千个稳定的 RL 步骤，并且在 AIME24/25 上比 DAPO 和其他竞争基线高出 4%-8%，为法学硕士长期 RL 训练后的熵感知信用分配提供了原则基础。We present STARE, a surprisal-guided token-level advantage reweighting mechanism that mitigates policy entropy collapse in GRPO-style RLVR. A first-order analysis of entropy dynamics reveals an advantage–surprisal four-quadrant structure and a near-criticality property. Guided by this insight, STARE reweights entropy-critical tokens via batch-internal surprisal quantiles, coupled with a target-entropy closed-loop gate for stable, minimally intrusive regulation. Across 1.5B–32B models and three task scenarios, STARE sustains thousands of stable RL steps and outperforms DAPO and other competitive baselines by 4%–8% on AIME24/25, offering a principled foundation for entropy-aware credit assignment in long-horizon RL post-training of LLMs.

附录AAppendix A相关工作Related Work

具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）。Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards(RLVR).近年来，大型语言模型（LLM）发展迅速In recent years, large language models (LLMs) have advanced rapidly(Achiam et al., 2023; Anthropic, 2025; Guo et al., 2025; Team et al., 2025b; Xu et al., 2024; Luo et al., 2024c)。 RLVR 已成为增强法学硕士推理能力的主要训练后范例，因为它利用可验证的信号提供精确的结果级奖励，同时避免学习奖励模型固有的过度拟合风险. RLVR has emerged as the dominant post-training paradigm for enhancing the reasoning capability of LLMs, as it leverages verifiable signals to provide precise outcome-level rewards while avoiding the overfitting risks inherent in learned reward models(Schulman et al., 2017; Kazemnejad et al., 2025; Gao et al., 2023)。 GRPO去除价值网络，通过群体归一化奖励来估计优势，在数学推理、代码生成和工具使用任务中表现出强大的有效性，并进一步引发长链推理和自我反思等紧急行为. GRPO removes the value network and estimates the advantage through group-normalized rewards, demonstrating strong effectiveness in mathematical reasoning, code generation, and tool-use tasks, and further eliciting emergent behaviors such as long chain-of-thought reasoning and self-reflection(Guo et al., 2025; Shao et al., 2024; Luo et al., 2023; Team et al., 2025b; Wei et al., 2022; Luo et al., 2024a; Chang et al., 2025; Luo et al., 2024b; Shen & Zhang, 2026; Luo et al., 2025)。后续研究将GRPO框架从优势估计、损失聚合和采样策略等多个维度进行了扩展，其中DAPO通过非对称裁剪、动态采样和代币级损失归一化的结合成为了具有代表性的基线. Subsequent studies extend the GRPO framework along several dimensions, including advantage estimation, loss aggregation, and sampling strategies, among which DAPO has become a representative baseline through a combination of asymmetric clipping, dynamic sampling, and token-level loss normalization(Yu et al., 2025; Yue et al., 2025b; Cheng et al., 2025; He et al., 2025c; Chen et al., 2026)。然而，随着训练进行更多的优化步骤，GRPO 式算法通常会遭受策略熵崩溃，其中熵迅速衰减，输出多样性消失，组内推出变得同质，并且可训练步骤的数量最终受到限制. As training proceeds over more optimization steps, however, GRPO-style algorithms commonly suffer from policy entropy collapse, in which the entropy decays rapidly, the output diversity vanishes, within-group rollouts become homogeneous, and the number of trainable steps is ultimately capped(Farquhar et al., 2024; Jin et al., 2025; Chen et al., 2025b; Yue et al., 2025a)。现有研究已经证实了这种现象的普遍存在，并建立了政策熵与下游绩效之间的经验相关性；然而，对于熵崩溃的潜在代币级梯度原因的细粒度理论描述仍然缺乏。. Existing studies have confirmed the prevalence of this phenomenon and have established empirical correlations between policy entropy and downstream performance; nevertheless, a fine-grained theoretical characterization of the underlying token-level gradient causes of entropy collapse remains absent.

熵崩溃缓解方法Entropy Collapse Mitigation Methods现有的缓解策略分为三类。第一类通过调整重要性采样比的裁剪阈值来保护低概率令牌，例如DAPO中的裁剪更高机制以及后续的差异化裁剪和平滑门控等变体；这些机制对熵的影响是不对称的，难以精确控制，并且在采样率接近于1的在策机制中，很少会激活削波，导致实际的调控能力有限.Existing mitigation strategies fall into three categories. The first category protects low-probability tokens by adjusting the clipping thresholds of the importance-sampling ratio, as exemplified by the clip-higher mechanism in DAPO and by subsequent variants such as differentiated clipping and smooth gating; the influence of these mechanisms on entropy is asymmetric and difficult to control precisely, and in the on-policy regime where the sampling ratio remains close to one, clipping is rarely activated, leaving the actual regulatory capacity limited(Yu et al., 2025; Yue et al., 2025b; Haarnoja et al., 2018; Chen et al., 2026; Xi et al., 2025; Zhou et al., 2026)。第二类在正负样本之间应用轨迹级差异化加权，包括非对称重要性采样和罕见正确推出的提升权重；由于这些方法在轨迹粒度上运行，因此它们无法区分同一轨迹内不同标记的相反熵效应. The second category applies trajectory-level differentiated weighting between positive and negative samples, including asymmetric importance sampling and the upweighting of rare correct rollouts; since these methods operate at the trajectory granularity, they cannot distinguish the opposing entropy effects of different tokens within the same trajectory(Zhu et al., 2025; Tang et al., 2025; Wang et al., 2025b; Deng et al., 2025; Yang et al., 2025a)。第三类通过熵诱导优势将代币级别的熵信息耦合到优势或损失中. The third category couples token-level entropy information into the advantage or loss through entropy-induced advantages(Cheng et al., 2025; Huang et al., 2025; He et al., 2025c; Cui et al., 2025)，显式熵正则化，或基于熵变化的标记过滤；熵奖励往往会过度放大高熵令牌的信号并引起振荡，正则化对其系数的选择仍然高度敏感，基于熵变化的方法要么依赖于有关未采样令牌的难以估计的信息，要么强加过于简化的二进制分区。此外，提高采样温度只会延迟而不是防止熵崩溃。总体而言，现有方法要么以过于粗粒度的方式运行，要么缺乏对潜在崩溃机制的原则性理解。, explicit entropy regularization, or token filtering based on entropy variation; entropy rewards tend to overamplify the signal of high-entropy tokens and induce oscillations, regularization remains highly sensitive to the choice of its coefficient, and entropy-variation-based methods either rely on hard-to-estimate information about unsampled tokens or impose oversimplified binary partitions. In addition, raising the sampling temperature only delays rather than prevents entropy collapse. Overall, existing methods either operate at an excessively coarse granularity or lack a principled understanding of the underlying collapse mechanism.

代币级别的视角和 STARE。Token-Level Perspectives and STARE.最近的研究开始关注单个代币的差异化贡献Recent studies have begun to focus on the differentiated contributions of individual tokens(Wang et al., 2025b; Tang et al., 2025; Wang et al., 2026; Chen et al., 2026; Zhu et al., 2025)。一些工作表明，一小部分高熵标记在 RLVR 中主导有效学习信号，并且仅对该子集执行梯度更新已经产生了有效的性能增益. Some works demonstrate that a small subset of high-entropy tokens dominates the effective learning signal in RLVR and that performing gradient updates only on this subset already yields efficient performance gains(Wang et al., 2025b);另一项工作是在推理链的决策分支点识别关键标记，并鼓励在这些位置进行探索; another line of work identifies critical tokens at decision branching points along reasoning chains and encourages exploration at these positions(Chen et al., 2026; Tang et al., 2025; Cheng et al., 2025; Yang et al., 2025a)。这些发现与本文中提出的分析相呼应。然而，大多数现有方法本质上仍然是启发式的，要么无法保持策略熵的稳定和可控，要么缺乏跨多种场景、模型规模和长期训练设置的全面验证。从代币级熵动力学的一阶分析开始，STARE 建立了优势-意外四象限分解，揭示了共享轨迹级优势下的信用​​分配不匹配以及近临界性属性；在此分析的基础上，STARE通过批处理内部的意外分位数代理识别熵关键代币，选择性地重新权衡其有效优势，并结合目标熵闭环门，从而通过对GRPO目标的微创修改，实现对策略熵的有原则的代币级别调节。 STARE 在从 1.5B 到 32B 的模型规模以及涵盖短 CoT、长 CoT 和工具使用场景的三个任务系列中进行了全面验证，在这些任务系列中，它始终如一地提供稳定的性能改进，并进一步释放长期 RL 训练的优化潜力。. These findings echo the analysis presented in this paper. Most existing methods, however, remain heuristic in nature and either fail to keep the policy entropy stable and controllable or lack comprehensive validation across multiple scenarios, model scales, and long-horizon training settings. Starting from a first-order analysis of token-level entropy dynamics, STARE establishes an advantage-surprisal four-quadrant decomposition that exposes the credit assignment mismatch under shared trajectory-level advantages, together with a near-criticality property; building on this analysis, STARE identifies entropy-critical tokens through a batch-internal surprisal-quantile proxy, selectively reweights their effective advantages, and incorporates a target-entropy closed-loop gate, thereby achieving principled token-level regulation of the policy entropy through a minimally invasive modification to the GRPO objective. STARE is comprehensively validated across model scales ranging from 1.5B to 32B and across three task families covering Short-CoT, Long-CoT, and tool-use scenarios, where it consistently delivers stable performance improvements and further unlocks the optimization potential of long-horizon RL training.

B.6 有关紧急反射行为的详细信息。Details about Emergent Reflection Behaviors.

为了研究 STARE 如何引发深层推理，我们分析了 RL 训练期间出现的反射行为。以 Qwen2.5-32B-Base 为代表，我们随机抽取了 STARE 和 GRPO-ds 共享的 50 个训练步骤。此分析旨在作为粗略的定性诊断，而不是推理深度的原则性测量：我们应用基于手动观察模式的启发式正则表达式匹配来获取与反射相关的标记的近似计数，分为六类：对比（To investigate how STARE elicits deep reasoning, we analyze the reflection behaviors that emerge during RL training. Taking Qwen2.5-32B-Base as a representative example, we randomly sample 50 training steps shared by both STARE and GRPO-ds. This analysis is intended as a coarse, qualitative diagnostic rather than a principled measurement of reasoning depth: we apply heuristic regular-expression matching based on manually-observed patterns to obtain an approximate count of reflection-related tokens, grouped into six categories: contrast (但是，但是but, however), 反射 (), reflection (等等，再考虑一下wait, reconsider），自我修正（), self-correction (犯了一个错误，纠正made a mistake, correct）、犹豫（), hesitation (也许，可能，或许perhaps, possibly, maybe），回溯（), backtracking (重新计算、重做、返回recalculate, redo, go back）和总结修订（), and summary revision (总结，最终summary, ultimately）。图). Figure13报告每 1k 个样本的反射相关令牌计数； STARE 在所有六个类别上都大大超过了 GRPO-d，在反思和自我纠正方面具有明显更大的余地，表明由此产生的政策保留了更强的探索和更大的产出多样性。数字reports reflection-related token counts per 1k samples; STARE substantially exceeds GRPO-ds across all six categories, with markedly larger margins on reflection and self-correction, indicating that the resulting policy retains stronger exploration and greater output diversity. Taken together, the emergent growth of reflection tokens and the semantic bias of the reweighted token distribution demonstrate that STARE activates the deep exploration capability of the model and delivers consistent performance gains through token-level credit rebalancing.

在 Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Base 上，我们比较了三种闭环门控粒度：On Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Base, we compare three closed-loop gating granularities: a token-level gate that evaluatesHi,t<HtgtH_{i,t}<H_{\text{tgt}}在每个位置，都有一个样本级门，用于调节每个样本平均熵的激活at each position, a sample-level gate that conditions activation on the per-sample average entropyH¯i\bar{H}_{i}，以及基于批次平均熵做出统一决策的批次级门, and a batch-level gate that makes a unified decision based on the batch-average entropyH¯k\bar{H}_{k}。如表所示. As reported in Table6，所有三个粒度都大大优于 GRPO-ds 基线 (35.2%/17.3%)，证实了闭环机制的总体有效性。批次级门产生最佳性能 (38.0%/20.0%)，超过了令牌级 (36.9%/19.1%) 和样本级 (37.6%/19.3%) 变体。由于令牌和样本级别的局部熵估计表现出较高的方差，因此它们往往会引起门控信号的频繁切换并破坏调节的稳定性。因此，我们在主要实验中采用批次级门作为默认设置。, all three granularities substantially outperform the GRPO-ds baseline (35.2%/17.3%), confirming the general effectiveness of the closed-loop mechanism. The batch-level gate yields the best performance (38.0%/20.0%), surpassing the token-level (36.9%/19.1%) and sample-level (37.6%/19.3%) variants. Since local entropy estimates at the token and sample levels exhibit higher variance, they tend to induce frequent switching of the gating signal and undermine the stability of the regulation. We therefore adopt the batch-level gate as the default setting in our main experiments.

在 GRPO 的未裁剪机制中，在给定的解码位置，局部代理目标相对于 logit 向量的梯度与In the unclipped regime of GRPO, at a given decoding position, the gradient of the local surrogate objective with respect to the logit vector is aligned with

A^​∇zlog⁡πθ​(a∣c).\hat{A}\,\nabla_{z}\log\pi_{\theta}(a\mid c).

将正比例常数吸收为无穷小的步长Absorbing the positive proportionality constant into an infinitesimal step sizeη>0\eta>0给出等效的 logit 更新gives the equivalent logit update

Δ​zv=η​A^​(δv​a−πv),v∈𝒱.\Delta z_{v}=\eta\,\hat{A}\,(\delta_{va}-\pi_{v}),\qquad v\in\mathcal{V}.
证明。Proof.

当裁剪未激活时，局部代理目标相对于模型参数的梯度方向与When clipping is inactive, the gradient direction of the local surrogate objective with respect to the model parameters is proportional to

A^​∇θlog⁡πθ​(a∣c).\hat{A}\,\nabla_{\theta}\log\pi_{\theta}(a\mid c).

根据链式法则，logit 空间中的等效上升方向为By the chain rule, an equivalent ascent direction in logit space is

∂∂zv​[A^​log⁡πθ​(a∣c)]=A^​∂∂zv​log⁡πa.\frac{\partial}{\partial z_{v}}\bigl[\hat{A}\log\pi_{\theta}(a\mid c)\bigr]=\hat{A}\,\frac{\partial}{\partial z_{v}}\log\pi_{a}.

而且，Moreover,

∂∂zv​log⁡πa=1πa​∂πa∂zv.\frac{\partial}{\partial z_{v}}\log\pi_{a}=\frac{1}{\pi_{a}}\frac{\partial\pi_{a}}{\partial z_{v}}.

替代命题Substituting PropositionD.1给出gives

∂πa∂zv=πa​(δv​a−πv),\frac{\partial\pi_{a}}{\partial z_{v}}=\pi_{a}(\delta_{va}-\pi_{v}),

因此and therefore

∂∂zv​log⁡πa=1πa⋅πa​(δv​a−πv)=δv​a−πv.\frac{\partial}{\partial z_{v}}\log\pi_{a}=\frac{1}{\pi_{a}}\cdot\pi_{a}(\delta_{va}-\pi_{v})=\delta_{va}-\pi_{v}.

因此Hence

∂∂zv​[A^​log⁡πa]=A^​(δv​a−πv).\frac{\partial}{\partial z_{v}}\bigl[\hat{A}\log\pi_{a}\bigr]=\hat{A}(\delta_{va}-\pi_{v}).

采取无穷小的梯度上升步骤产生Taking an infinitesimal gradient ascent step yields

Δ​zv=η​A^​(δv​a−πv).\Delta z_{v}=\eta\,\hat{A}(\delta_{va}-\pi_{v}).

这就证明了结果。 ∎This proves the result. ∎

E.5 共享轨迹级优势下的不对称熵贡献Asymmetric Entropy Contributions under Shared Trajectory-Level Advantages

本小节提供了第 1 节中总结的不对称熵贡献的详细定量分析This subsection provides the detailed quantitative analysis of the asymmetric entropy contributions summarized in Section3.2.

考虑分配了正优势的轨迹子集（Consider the subset of trajectories assigned positive advantages (A^i>0\hat{A}_{i}>0）。因为推出是从当前政策中抽样的). Because rollouts are sampled from the current policyπθ\pi_{\theta}，在每个解码位置抽出低惊喜令牌的概率高于抽出高惊喜令牌的概率。在正优势轨迹内，熵减少的代币（低意外，, the probability of drawing a low-surprisal token at each decoding position is higher than that of drawing a high-surprisal token. Within positive-advantage trajectories, entropy-decreasing tokens (low surprisal,Φ>0\Phi>0）因此通过采样频率构成了统计多数，而熵增加的标记（高度令人惊讶，) therefore constitute the statistical majority by sampling frequency, while entropy-increasing tokens (high surprisal,Φ<0\Phi<0）仍然是统计上的少数。表示) remain a statistical minority. Denotingpi,t=πθ​(oi,t∣xi,oi,<t)p_{i,t}=\pi_{\theta}(o_{i,t}\mid x_{i},o_{i,<t})和and𝔰i,t=−ln⁡pi,t\mathfrak{s}_{i,t}=-\ln p_{i,t}，来自正优势样本的净一阶熵贡献分解为, the net first-order entropy contribution from positive-advantage samples decomposes as

d​H¯+d​η|η=0=1N​[−∑i,t:A^i>0𝔰i,t<𝔰i,t∗A^i​Φi,t⏟entropy-decreasing majority(<0)+∑i,t:A^i>0𝔰i,t>𝔰i,t∗A^i​|Φi,t|⏟entropy-increasing minority(>0)].\left.\frac{d\bar{H}^{+}}{d\eta}\right|_{\eta=0}=\frac{1}{N}\bigg[\underbrace{-\!\!\!\sum_{\begin{subarray}{c}i,t:\,\hat{A}_{i}>0\\ \mathfrak{s}_{i,t}<\mathfrak{s}^{*}_{i,t}\end{subarray}}\hat{A}_{i}\,\Phi_{i,t}}_{\text{entropy-decreasing majority}\;(<0)}\;+\;\underbrace{\sum_{\begin{subarray}{c}i,t:\,\hat{A}_{i}>0\\ \mathfrak{s}_{i,t}>\mathfrak{s}^{*}_{i,t}\end{subarray}}\hat{A}_{i}\,|\Phi_{i,t}|}_{\text{entropy-increasing minority}\;(>0)}\bigg].

在 GRPO 训练期间，轨迹内的所有令牌共享单个轨迹级优势During GRPO training, all tokens within a trajectory share a single trajectory-level advantageA^i\hat{A}_{i}，使得算法无法区分这两个标记类别的相反熵效应。这一观察结果揭示了 GRPO 熵崩溃背后的基本梯度水平机制。在共享的轨迹水平优势下，强化的低意外多数系统性地推动分布趋向集中，熵减少的贡献在预期中占主导地位。相比之下，能够保持多样性的高度令人惊讶的少数人贡献的熵增加效应有限。对批次进行聚合后，最终结果是熵的系统减少。类似但镜像的不对称控制着负优势子集。, leaving the algorithm unable to distinguish the opposing entropy effects of these two token categories. This observation reveals a fundamental gradient-level mechanism underlying entropy collapse in GRPO. Under the shared trajectory-level advantage, the reinforced low-surprisal majority systematically drives the distribution toward concentration, with entropy-decreasing contributions dominating in expectation. In contrast, the high-surprisal minority that could preserve diversity contributes limited entropy-increasing effects. Upon aggregation over the batch, the net outcome is a systematic reduction in entropy. An analogous but mirror-image asymmetry governs the negative-advantage subset.

本附录在第 5 节中进行了动态讨论This appendix casts the dynamical discussion in Section3.4作为平均场闭包下的离散时间系统。目的是将正文中描述的定性机制形式化。它并不是用于一般深度神经网络训练的无条件全局收敛定理。as a discrete-time system under a mean-field closure. The purpose is to formalize the qualitative mechanism described in the main text. It is not intended as an unconditional global convergence theorem for general deep neural network training.

H.3 单极与联合作战总结Summary of Single-Polarity and Combined Operations

为了清楚起见，我们总结了下面的单极性操作 O1 至 O4 和组合操作 C1 至 C4。For clarity, we summarize the single-polarity operations O1 to O4 and the combined operations C1 to C4 below.

单极性运算作用于一个熵象限：Single-polarity operations act on one entropy quadrant:

  • •

    O1 放大O1 amplifiesℒq+\mathcal{L}_{q}^{+}，积极优势高惊喜集。它在正优势下强化了熵增少数。, the positive-advantage high-surprisal set. It strengthens the entropy-increasing minority under positive advantages.

  • •

    O2衰减O2 attenuates𝒰q+\mathcal{U}_{q}^{+}，正优势低惊喜集。它削弱了正优势下占主导地位的熵减信号。, the positive-advantage low-surprisal set. It weakens the dominant entropy-decreasing signal under positive advantages.

  • •

    O3 放大O3 amplifies𝒰q−\mathcal{U}_{q}^{-}，负优势低惊喜集。它加强了通过抑制低惊喜令牌而引起的熵增加效应。, the negative-advantage low-surprisal set. It strengthens the entropy-increasing effect induced by suppressing low-surprisal tokens.

  • •

    O4 减弱O4 attenuatesℒq−\mathcal{L}_{q}^{-}，负优势高惊喜集。它削弱了通过抑制高惊喜令牌而引起的熵减少效应。, the negative-advantage high-surprisal set. It weakens the entropy-decreasing effect induced by suppressing high-surprisal tokens.

第节四象限分析下Under the four-quadrant analysis in Section3.2、O1 和 O3 放大熵增加信号，而 O2 和 O4 减弱熵减少信号。正文中的变体 I 是 O1 的直接实例，因为它仅放大了, O1 and O3 amplify entropy-increasing signals, whereas O2 and O4 attenuate entropy-decreasing signals. Variant I in the main text is a direct instance of O1, since it only amplifies token weights inℒq+\mathcal{L}_{q}^{+}.

组合运算作用于两个熵象限：Combined operations act on two entropy quadrants:

  • •

    C1联合放大C1 jointly amplifiesℒq+\mathcal{L}_{q}^{+}和and𝒰q−\mathcal{U}_{q}^{-}。它增强了正面和负面优势双方的熵增加信号。. It strengthens entropy-increasing signals on both the positive- and negative-advantage sides.

  • •

    C2 放大C2 amplifiesℒq+\mathcal{L}_{q}^{+}并减弱and attenuatesℒq−\mathcal{L}_{q}^{-}。它同时强化了正优势高惊奇熵增代币，削弱了负优势高惊奇熵减少代币。. It simultaneously strengthens positive-advantage high-surprisal entropy-increasing tokens and weakens negative-advantage high-surprisal entropy-decreasing tokens.

  • •

    C3 衰减C3 attenuates𝒰q+\mathcal{U}_{q}^{+}并放大and amplifies𝒰q−\mathcal{U}_{q}^{-}。它通过削弱正优势熵减代币和加强负优势熵增代币来调节低意外区域。. It regulates the low-surprisal region by weakening positive-advantage entropy-decreasing tokens and strengthening negative-advantage entropy-increasing tokens.

  • •

    C4联合衰减C4 jointly attenuates𝒰q+\mathcal{U}_{q}^{+}和andℒq−\mathcal{L}_{q}^{-}。它抑制了两个主要的熵减少标记类别。. It suppresses the two dominant entropy-decreasing token categories.

正文中的变体II是C2的代表实例。它结合了放大Variant II in the main text is a representative instance of C2. It combines amplification ofℒq+\mathcal{L}_{q}^{+}随着衰减with attenuation ofℒq−\mathcal{L}_{q}^{-}。由于所有权重均保持为正，因此保留了每个原始 GRPO 策略梯度更新的符号。该方法仅重新调整令牌级别的贡献大小，从而通过两种互补机制调节批次级别的熵动态：放大熵增加的贡献和减弱熵减少的贡献。. Since all weights remain positive, the sign of each original GRPO policy-gradient update is preserved. The method only rescales token-level contribution magnitudes, thereby regulating batch-level entropy dynamics through two complementary mechanisms: amplifying entropy-increasing contributions and attenuating entropy-decreasing contributions.

单极运行对单个熵象限进行针对性干预，联合运行则跨两个象限进行联合调控。Single-polarity operations implement targeted interventions on individual entropy quadrants, while combined operations perform joint regulation across two quadrants.

在这里，Here,ℒq+\mathcal{L}_{q}^{+}和andℒq−\mathcal{L}_{q}^{-}分别表示正优势标记和负优势标记中的高度令人惊讶的代理子集，而denote high-surprisal proxy subsets within positive- and negative-advantage tokens, respectively, while𝒰q+\mathcal{U}_{q}^{+}和and𝒰q−\mathcal{U}_{q}^{-}表示正面和负面优势标记中的低意外代理子集。放大是指分配大于 1 的权重，而衰减是指分配大于 1 的权重denote low-surprisal proxy subsets within positive- and negative-advantage tokens. Amplification refers to assigning weights larger than one, whereas attenuation refers to assigning weights in(0,1)(0,1).

附录一Appendix I局限性和更广泛的影响Limitations and Broader Impacts

我们的实证评估可能无法详尽地涵盖所有可能的任务分配和优化设置。此外，与其他法学硕士类似，我们训练的模型有时也可能生成潜在的不道德或误导性信息。我们希望我们的工作能够为大型语言模型开发更可靠的训练后范例做出积极贡献。Our empirical evaluation may not exhaustively cover all possible task distributions and optimization settings. Moreover, similar to other LLMs, our trained model could also generate potentially unethical or misleading information sometimes. We hope our work contributes positively to the development of more reliable post-training paradigms for large language models.
